decided: Each skill's description, the short text that tells the user and the AI what the skill does and when to use it, will be written so a strict reader of the file format accepts it; the review-walk skill's description is cut from about 1,140 to about 300 characters; the architect and onboarding skills gain a sentence on when to use them; and the drift-scan skill's description is corrected from four categories to the six it runs.
alternatives: reword only the three descriptions a strict reader refuses today, leaving later ones to break the same way
leave the descriptions as they are, since the reader Claude Code uses accepts them
why: RG2 asks for descriptions that are valid, at most 1,024 characters, and say what the skill does and when to use it; fixing the way every description is written, rather than three of them, keeps the next one valid too, and the shorter walk description costs every session less.
detail: generateSkillContent writes description bare; metadata already goes through yamlScalar. The yaml package refuses orbit-address-reviews, orbit-architect and orbit-review frontmatter at a5ba0f0c.
